name: Guided T8 leadscrew nut (rail-carried)
description: A T8 nut in a carrier that rides an MGN12 rail: the rail blocks the nut's rotation about the screw (a plain nut spins with its screw and everything hanging from it yaws). Connect thread to the screw, rail_side to a rail, mount to the load. The rail must be parallel to the screw.
